gloss_en: Death (mitah) — the noun denoting dying / the state or event of death, opposed to life (chayim); includes death as the counterpart of darkness, foolishness and the body, death of the condemned (who confess before execution), and punishments figuratively termed 'death'. Not מַטָּה (bed/staff) or any other homograph; verbal inflections of the root מ-ו-ת (e.g., וּמֵתָה 'and it dies') expressing this same sense of dying belong here.
